verbose.description: Enable verbose output to syslog when the firewall starts/stops.

log_drops.description: Log dropped packets to syslog with REASON and packet details.

log_refused.description: Log refused connection attempts to syslog.

log_facility.description: Syslog facility to use for firewall logs (e.g., daemon, local0).

nat_enabled.description: Enable NAT/masquerading for outbound traffic to the Internet.

internal_hosts.description: List of internal (private) IP subnets or host addresses to protect.

items.description: CIDR block or single IP address representing a protected internal subnet/host.

external_interface.description: Name of the external (WAN) network interface (e.g., eth0, ppp0).

dmz_enabled.description: Enable a demilitarized zone (DMZ) for semi-trusted services.

dmz_hosts.description: List of DMZ subnets or hosts (only used if DMZ is enabled).

items.description: CIDR block or IP address of a host in the DMZ.

dmz_interface.description: Name of the interface connected to the DMZ network (required if DMZ enabled).

pppoe_interface.description: Name of the PPPoE interface (e.g., ppp0) when ADSL is enabled.

syn_flood_protect.description: Enable TCP SYN flood protection (rate-limit new TCP connections).

icmp_ping_rate_limit.description: Maximum ICMP echo requests (ping) per second allowed from external sources.

inbound_services.description: List of services (ports or named services like 'ssh', 'http') to allow inbound.

items.description: Port number (e.g., 22) or well-known service name (e.g., ssh, http).

allow_inbound_ssh.description: Allow inbound SSH connections from the Internet (not recommended unless needed).

ssh_only_from_internal.description: Allow SSH only from internal (protected) networks, even if 'allow_inbound_ssh' is false.

forward_dmz.description: Allow traffic forwarding between internal network and DMZ.

forward_internal.description: Allow forwarding between multiple internal interfaces (multi-homed only).

log_forward.description: Log forwarded packets to syslog for auditing.

custom_rules.description: List of additional raw iptables rules (must be valid iptables -A syntax).

items.description: One full iptables append rule (e.g., '-A INPUT -p tcp --dport 8080 -j ACCEPT').

stateful.description: Enable stateful packet inspection (track established connections).

randomize_outbound_ports.description: Randomize source port ranges for outbound NAT connections (improves security).

allow_dns_inbound.description: Allow DNS responses from your own DNS servers (e.g., if running BIND locally).
